title: Add keepdim parameter to cosine_similarity
body:
Fixes #149120

Adds a `keepdim` parameter to `torch.cosine_similarity`, consistent with other reduction-like ops (`sum`, `norm`, `pairwise_distance`).

```python
>>> x1 = torch.randn(2, 3, 4)
>>> x2 = torch.randn(2, 3, 4)
>>> torch.cosine_similarity(x1, x2, dim=1).shape
torch.Size([2, 4])
>>> torch.cosine_similarity(x1, x2, dim=1, keepdim=True).shape
torch.Size([2, 1, 4])
```

**Changes:**
- `native_functions.yaml`: Add `bool keepdim=False` to `cosine_similarity` schema
- `Distance.cpp`: Pass `keepdim` to final `.sum(dim, keepdim)` call
- C++ API: Add `keepdim` to `CosineSimilarityOptions`, plumb through functional and module layers
- ONNX symbolic: Accept `keepdim` and pass to `keepdims_i` in reduce ops
- `torch/overrides.py`: Add `keepdim` to override lambda
- Tests: Add `keepdim=True` shape and value tests in Python (`test_nn.py`, OpInfo samples) and C++ (`modules.cpp`)

The default `keepdim=False` preserves full backward compatibility.

**Note:** Per the FC window policy, a follow-up PR will update the Python frontend (`F.cosine_similarity` docstring and `nn.CosineSimilarity` module) to expose `keepdim` after these C++ changes land.

cc @mikaylagawarecki @jbschlosser
